$comment: 1Password -> GitHub environment secrets allowlist, consumed by the shared supa-sync-1password-to-github bin (Supa-Media/supa-framework) via .github/workflows/sync-secrets.yml. A key not listed here is NEVER synced. Each key must exist in the `Crystal` vault as an item titled exactly as the key, with a field named after the environment (`production`). See docs/CONNECTIONS.md.
$scope: Only secrets that GitHub Actions itself reads belong here. The backend's own secrets (RESEND_API_KEY, JWT_PRIVATE_KEY, JWKS, SITE_URL) go straight from 1Password to the Convex deployment via `pnpm push:secrets --prod` — routing them through GitHub would mean three copies of the same value and one more place for them to drift.
$optionalNote: Keys listed as `optional` are DELETED from the GitHub environment when absent from 1Password, so a deploy can never read a stale value. Nothing needs that yet.
